description_en: Binds a multi-factor authentication (MFA) device to a Resource Access Management (RAM) user
description_zh: 为RAM用户绑定指定的多因素认证设备
kebab_example: aliyun ims bind-mfa-device --serial-number acs:ram::1772422852740000:mfa/device001 --user-principal-name test@example.onaliyun.com --authentication-code-1 123456 --authentication-code-2 654321 --region cn-hangzhou
name: BindMFADevice

parameters.description_en:
The serial number of the MFA device.

> You can call the [CreateVirtualMFADevice](~~186179~~) operation to obtain the serial number of the MFA device.
parameters.description_zh:
多因素认证设备的序列号。

> 您可以调用[CreateVirtualMFADevice](~~186179~~)获取多因素认证设备的序列号。
parameters.help_en:
The serial number of the MFA device.

parameters.help_zh:

parameters.name: serial_number

parameters.description_en: The logon name of the RAM user.
parameters.help_en: The logon name of the RAM user
parameters.name: user_principal_name

parameters.description_en:
The first verification code.

> You can call the [CreateVirtualMFADevice](~~186179~~) operation to create an MFA device and generate a key (value of `Base32StringSeed`). Then, use the key on the Alibaba Cloud app to manually add an MFA device, and obtain the two consecutive verification codes.
parameters.description_zh:
第一组安全验证码。

> 您可以调用[CreateVirtualMFADevice](~~186179~~)创建多因素认证设备并生成密钥（`Base32StringSeed`的值），然后使用该密钥在移动端阿里云应用中手动添加多因素认证设备，最后获取连续的两组安全验证码。
